name: Baku
source:
Deep within the forest, a certain monastery also served as an orphanage, taking in and raising orphaned children. However, this was merely a facade; in reality, it was a facility where orphans were sexually exploited and trained to become “maids” who would please influential figures.
Unaware of what was taking place there, a young man (the protagonist) arrived to serve as the monastery’s priest.
Will the protagonist end up getting involved in these depraved acts…!? 

[MTLed from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/627/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
森林深处，某座寺院同时也是孤儿院，收养孤儿。然而，这只是表面现象。事实上，这是一个孤儿遭受性剥削并被训练成为取悦有影响力人物的“女佣”的设施。
一位年轻人（主角）不知道那里发生了什么，来到修道院担任牧师。
主角最终会卷入这些堕落的行径吗……！？

[来自[url=https://www.getchu.com/item/627/]Getchu[/url] 的]
